## Release guidance
- If this PR should trigger a release, please add one of these labels to the PR:
  - `release:patch` — bugfixes, small non-breaking changes
  - `release:minor` — new backwards-compatible features
  - `release:major` — breaking changes

(Optional) If you want the changelog to pick up this change nicely, set the squash/merge commit title to start with `feat:` for features or `fix:` for fixes.
